title: A Rota That Left the Weekend Free
story: Four flats shared one washing line, and the old habit gave it to whoever arrived first. After two quarrels about sheets left wet overnight, Amina posted a rota that gave each flat one weekday and left the weekend blank. Neighbours called a laundry timetable absurd. Amina was not trying to police spare hours. She was ending a race that favoured anyone who worked at home and could hang clothes at noon. The weekend stayed open because guests and emergencies happen. A rule for every hour would have been resented, rightly. The narrower rule lasted because it corrected the unfair part and left the rest alone.

quiz.question: What share of the week did each flat receive?
options: One weekday
The entire weekend
Every noon hour
Two nights for wet sheets
quiz.explanation: The rota gave each flat one weekday.
quiz.supportingSentence: After two quarrels about sheets left wet overnight, Amina posted a rota that gave each flat one weekday and left the weekend blank.

quiz.question: Why was the weekend left blank?
options: Guests and emergencies still happen
The line was removed every Friday
Amina worked only on Saturdays
Wet sheets were banned after noon
quiz.explanation: The weekend stayed open because guests and emergencies happen.
quiz.supportingSentence: The weekend stayed open because guests and emergencies happen.

quiz.question: Who had the advantage before the rota?
options: People at home by day, who could take the line at noon
Guests who arrived only on Mondays
Neighbours who never did laundry
A clerk who rented the line out
quiz.correctAnswer: People at home by day, who could take the line at noon
quiz.explanation: The old race favoured anyone who worked at home and could hang clothes at noon.
quiz.supportingSentence: She was ending a race that favoured anyone who worked at home and could hang clothes at noon.

quiz.question: What does resented mean for a rule covering every hour?
options: People would feel bitter about it
It would be printed in larger type
It would dry clothes faster
It would erase the weekend from the calendar
quiz.correctAnswer: People would feel bitter about it
quiz.explanation: Resented means people would bitterly dislike a rule that covered every hour.
quiz.supportingSentence: A rule for every hour would have been resented, rightly.

quiz.question: Why add that resentment of a total rule would be proper?
options: To justify stopping short of controlling every hour
To admit the rota was torn down at once
To blame the guests for both quarrels
To name one soap for every flat
quiz.correctAnswer: To justify stopping short of controlling every hour
quiz.explanation: Calling that resentment rightful defends the choice to leave some time unregulated.
quiz.supportingSentence: A rule for every hour would have been resented, rightly.
